items.title: Sam Kininger interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, May 27, 2011
items.q: we listened to old Wes Montgomery type things, like and George Benson style things

ctx.x: Of course Soulive is not a guitar — well

They are. I mean they started out as like an organ trio situation, like we listened to old Wes Montgomery type things, like and George Benson style things, or who else, Lou Donaldson type. It was definitely an organ trio you know. Let’s say Lettuce is like equally guitar and horn with the emphasis on the guitar and the horns.
What do you, are you a goal-oriented person?
